items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: Ramsey and I were trying to get money together to have Dr. Bessie get a set of false teeth for Bunk.

ctx.x: The Bessie Smith chapter. And then after, he sort of defaulted on it. Not because of the bad intentions. He really intended to try to do it, but he was just doing too many things. As I say, when he talked all afternoon there and could hardly get in a word. I remember on the way out, then I was collecting money for Bunk's teeth at that time, too. Ramsey and I were trying to get money together to have Dr. Bessie get a set of false teeth for Bunk. And Hammond made some remark. Of course, Bunk will never play again,…
I understand that Columbia did not have the original presses of Bessie Smith. They had destroyed them all or thrown them away.
